sermon.title: Is Jesus Christ the Same Today Concerning the Nations as Yesterday? — October 31, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor Kincer asks whether Jesus Christ is the same toward nations as yesterday. From Babel and Nimrod through Cyrus and Daniel 2, God has always ruled in the kingdoms of men, using nations to correct nations. A nation’s long-term success depends on righteousness, and a remnant still pursues it.
